needed.evidence: footway is under 1m and partly blocked by obstructions
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous, usable sidewalk at least 1m wide along the left side of the road.

needed.evidence: footway is partly blocked by parked vehicles or other obstructions
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions from the footway to ensure it is fully usable for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: uneven sections and trip hazards on the footway
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the footway to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: pedestrians crossing the road without a designated crossing facility
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at this location to provide a safe crossing point for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: no kerb ramps at potential crossing points
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at pedestrian crossings to ensure accessibility for all users.

needed.evidence: street lighting is only some, with gaps in visibility
needed.suggestion: Install additional street lights to ensure ample lighting along the entire road.
